Players

Select 1, 2, or all 3 Honors. The score is calculated automatically.
#PlayerBuildHonorsScoreMatch Group

Bracket

CH and EURO are two completely separate tournaments. CH players only face CH players, EURO players only face EURO players. If either tournament has an odd number of players, its 3 lowest Honor Score players enter its own Lucky Critical. No player receives a BYE.

Honor System

A player can have any combination of Bronze, Silver, and Golden.

  • Bronze = 1
  • Silver = 1
  • Golden = 1
  • Two categories = 2
  • All three categories = 3
  • None = 0

Matchmaking

CH and EURO are separate tournaments. CH can only play CH, and EURO can only play EURO. Within each tournament, Build/Match Group and Honor Score are used for matchmaking. If that tournament has an odd number of players, its 3 lowest Honor Score players enter a Lucky Critical; the winner advances and the other two play each other. No player receives a BYE.

Access permissions

Staff accounts can access only Players and Rules, and can add, edit, or delete players. Only admin@legion.com can access Tournament and use Generate / Update Tournament.

Persistence

Roster is shared online through Firebase Firestore. Sign-in is required.
